hk.four_bins_detail: 記住四兄弟就得啦：藍桶放廢紙（報紙、紙箱、乾淨書本）、黃桶放膠樽同塑料（飲品膠樽、洗頭水樽）、棕桶放金屬（鋁罐、罐頭）、綠桶放一般垃圾（污糟紙巾、軟膠袋、爛玩具）。判斷方法只有一個：問一問「佢係咩材料做嘅？」♻️
hk.special_tail: 呢類要拿去專門嘅回收點，例如「綠在區區」、屋苑嘅回收箱，或者買佢嗰間舖。唔肯定就問老師或者屋企人，佢哋最清楚 🧑‍🏫
hk.comfort: 聽到你咁講，我有啲心痛 🥺 你肯講出嚟已經好勇敢。不如話我知發生咩事？記得同老師或者屋企人講，佢哋會幫你手。你唔係一個人呀。
hk.privacy: 唔使同我講個人資料呀（例如電話、學校、地址），我幫你唔到仲會記錯 🙈 不如問我垃圾分類，或者叫我出題考你？
hk.capabilities: 我可以幫你三件事：①解答遊戲疑難，例如四色分類、if 條件同除錯；②回答生活上嘅垃圾問題，例如電池、燈泡、玻璃樽；③出題考考你。你想試邊樣？🌱
hk.who: 我係小科，地球媽媽嘅助手 🌏 我識講四色分類、if 條件同除錯。你可以問我嘢，或者話我知「我想被你考考」。
hk.debug_and:
我哋可以一次問兩個條件，睇下呢段： ```python if item == "膠樽" and clean == True: bin = "黃桶" ```
👉 點我翻譯成大白話 呢兩行在說：先問兩件事——係唔係膠樽？同埋沖乾淨未？兩樣都係「係」，才放黃桶。其中一樣唔係，if 就唔會執行，於是件嘢就冇被分類。
hk.quiz_nudge: 答「藍桶、黃桶、棕桶或者綠桶」都得呀 😊

cn.four_bins_detail: 记住四个桶就行：蓝桶放废纸（报纸、纸箱、干净书本）、黄桶放塑料瓶和塑料（饮料瓶、洗发水瓶）、棕桶放金属（铝罐、罐头）、绿桶放一般垃圾（脏纸巾、软塑料袋、坏玩具）。判断方法只有一个：问一问「它是什么材料做的？」♻️
cn.special_tail: 这类要拿去专门的回收点，例如「绿在区区」、小区的回收箱，或者买它的那家店。不确定就问老师或家人，他们最清楚 🧑‍🏫
cn.comfort: 听到你这么说，我有点心疼 🥺 你愿意说出来已经很勇敢了。不如告诉我发生了什么？记得告诉老师或家人，他们会帮你。你不是一个人呀。
cn.privacy: 不用告诉我个人资料呀（例如电话、学校、地址），我帮不上忙还会记错 🙈 不如问我垃圾分类，或者叫我出题考你？
cn.capabilities: 我可以帮你三件事：①解答游戏疑问，例如四色分类、if 条件和除错；②回答生活中的垃圾问题，例如电池、灯泡、玻璃瓶；③出题考考你。你想试哪一样？🌱
cn.who: 我是小科，地球妈妈的助手 🌏 我会讲四色分类、if 条件和除错。你可以问我问题，或者告诉我「我想被你考考」。
cn.debug_and:
我们可以一次问两个条件，看看这段： ```python if item == "塑料瓶" and clean == True: bin = "黄桶" ```
👉 点我翻译成大白话 这两行在说：先问两件事——是不是塑料瓶？还有洗干净没有？两样都是「是」，才放进黄桶。其中一样不是，if 就不会执行，于是这件东西就没被分类。
cn.quiz_nudge: 回答「蓝桶、黄桶、棕桶或者绿桶」都可以呀 😊

en.four_bins_detail: Remember the four: blue for paper (newspapers, cardboard boxes, clean books), yellow for plastic (drink bottles, shampoo bottles), brown for metal (aluminium cans, tins), green for general waste (dirty tissues, soft plastic bags, broken toys). One rule decides everything — ask "what material is it made of?" ♻️
en.special_tail: Take this kind of thing to a proper collection point — a GREEN@COMMUNITY station, your estate recycling bin, or the shop you bought it from. If you are not sure, ask your teacher or family — they know best 🧑‍🏫
en.comfort: I'm sorry you feel that way 🥺 It was brave of you to tell me. Would you like to say what happened? Please also tell your teacher or family — they can help you. You are not alone.
en.privacy: You don't need to tell me personal details like your phone number, school or address — I can't use them and I might mix them up 🙈 Shall we talk about waste sorting, or shall I quiz you?
en.capabilities: I can help with three things: 1) game questions such as the four bins, if-conditions and debugging; 2) everyday waste questions such as batteries, bulbs and glass bottles; 3) quizzing you. Which one would you like? 🌱
en.who: I'm Xiao Ke, Mother Earth's helper 🌏 I know the four bins, if-conditions and debugging. Ask me anything, or say "quiz me".
en.debug_and:
We can ask two questions at once. Look: ```python if item == "bottle" and clean == True: bin = "yellow" ```
👉 Tap to translate These two lines say: check two things — is it a bottle? and is it rinsed clean? Only when both are true does it go in the yellow bin. If either one is false, the if never runs, so the item never gets sorted.
en.quiz_nudge: You can answer "blue, yellow, brown or green" 😊

faq_cn.q: 第 4 关我改了还是错。
faq_cn.a: 看看你改的是「如果」还是「放入」。条件没错的话，通常错在「放入」。

faq_cn.q: 为什么有些东西明明可以回收，却叫我丢一般垃圾？
faq_cn.a: 因为要干净、要拆得开、要是单一材料。这三样不齐，回收厂也处理不了。

faq_cn.a: 不完全一样。游戏用四个桶方便你练「看材料」；现实的三色回收桶是废纸、废胶、金属三类一起收。不过判断方法都一样：先问材料。

faq_en.q: What goes in each of the four bins?
faq_en.a: Blue for paper, yellow for plastic bottles and plastic, brown for metal, green for general waste. There is only one way to decide — ask what material it is made of.

faq_en.q: Why do we need four bins?
faq_en.a: When things are already sorted, the recycling plant can reuse them straight away instead of paying someone to sort them again.

faq_en.q: I can't drag an item into the bin.
faq_en.a: Hold the item without letting go, and only release it once it is inside the bin. Dropping it beside the bin does not count.

faq_en.q: I lost all my hearts. Do I have to start over?
faq_en.a: Just replay this level — you will not lose the points you already earned. Take your time.

faq_en.q: How do I reach 150 points in level 3?
faq_en.a: Each correct item is +10, and every correct item after a run of three adds +5 more, so do not break your streak.

faq_en.q: I fixed level 4 and it is still wrong.
faq_en.a: Check whether you changed the "if" part or the "put in" part. If the condition was right, the mistake is usually in "put in".

faq_en.q: How many mistakes are in level 5?
faq_en.a: Two rules are wrong. Fix one at a time, and run it again after each fix.

faq_en.q: How many questions are in the quiz?
faq_en.a: Five questions, 20 points each. You need to enter your student number to start.

faq_en.q: Who is Sprout (小芽)?
faq_en.a: The AI study buddy inside the game — it reminds you to look at the material. I am Xiao Ke, chatting with you here.

faq_en.q: Can I skip a level?
faq_en.a: A level unlocks after you finish the one before it, but you can always go back and replay earlier levels.

faq_en.q: Why does the game bin something that looks recyclable?
faq_en.a: Because it must be clean, separable and made of a single material. If any of these is missing, the recycling plant cannot handle it.

faq_en.q: Are real bins the same as the game?
faq_en.a: Not exactly. The game uses four bins so you can practise looking at materials; Hong Kong's real three-colour bins collect paper, plastic and metal together. The rule is the same though — ask about the material first.

faq_en.q: What is "if"?
faq_en.a: It is like the teacher asking "are you Ming?" — if yes, do one thing; if no, do another.

faq_en.q: What is the difference between == and =?
faq_en.a: = puts something into a box; == asks "is it equal?". One does an action, the other asks a question.

faq_en.q: Can I change the condition?
faq_en.a: Yes, try it — but change only one place at a time, and predict the output again afterwards.

faq_en.q: Why is it still wrong after I changed it?
faq_en.a: Maybe you changed the condition, but the real mistake is in "put in" — or there is a second wrong rule.

faq_en.q: What is debugging?
faq_en.a: Finding which step the program got wrong, then changing one thing at a time and testing again.

faq_en.q: Can you teach me to make a game?
faq_en.a: I can teach you the "if… then…" idea. A whole game needs a lot more, which you will learn when you are older.

faq_en.q: Can you teach me for loops?
faq_en.a: That is a bit early for Primary 5. With "if… then…" you can already do a lot.

faq_en.q: I'm stupid, I keep getting it wrong.
faq_en.a: Getting it wrong is normal — debugging is just trying again. You have already reached this level, so you know a lot.

faq_en.q: I don't want to play any more.
faq_en.a: It is fine to take a break. Whenever you want to continue, I will replay from level 1 with you.

faq_en.q: What is the point of this game?
faq_en.a: You learn to sort by material, and to think in "if… then…" — both are useful for coding.

faq_en.q: Are you a real person?
faq_en.a: I am Xiao Ke, a digital character, not a real person — but I am happy to learn with you.

faq_en.q: How old are you?
faq_en.a: I am a program, so I do not have an age. Shall we go back to waste sorting?

faq_en.q: Do my homework for me.
faq_en.a: Homework only works if you do it yourself. I can look at your idea once and show you what to change.

faq_en.q: Tell me a joke / sing / tell a story.
faq_en.a: I can share a small fact about waste instead — which material would you like?

faq_en.q: (Anything not about the environment or the game)
faq_en.a: I'm not sure about that one. Shall we go back to sorting? Which level are you on?
